plain: An official whose job is to inquire and question people closely.

webster.text: One who inquires; particularly, one whose official duty it is to inquire and examine.

more.text: A member of the court of inquisition in Catholic countries.

example.quote: But every state, says an inquisitor, has established some religion.
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Notes on the State of Virginia, Query XVII (Religion) (1802 ed.)
